full_prompt_en: A square duotone fashion photograph frames a woman from the chest upward, her face divided by a perfectly vertical line between cool teal and glowing golden orange. The background follows the same division, teal on the left and flat orange on the right, so the color boundary passes through both the person and the space behind her. She faces forward with a composed, slightly distant expression. Her dark hair is gathered into a loose textured updo, with a few softer strands along the sides. The left half of the face sits in blue-green shadow, while the right half is rendered in orange and yellow light. Both eyes remain visible on either side of the seam; the nose and lips are bisected by it, emphasizing the symmetry of the crop. One hand rises near the right side of her neck, its fingers outlined by the warm light. A textured knit or mesh-like garment covers her shoulders, its tiny repeated pattern legible in both color zones. The left shoulder is dark teal against a brighter teal ground, while the right shoulder is orange against a saturated gold background. The photograph preserves natural facial modeling beneath the color treatment: subtle cheek volume, eyelids, hair texture, and garment folds remain visible, even though neutral tones have been replaced. Light is fairly soft and frontal, with a strong color shift rather than a hard physical shadow at the central border. The lower corners darken slightly around the garment, but the upper background stays clean and broad. The overall composition is direct and graphic, letting a single central seam hold the poised figure between two opposing luminous temperatures.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形双色时尚照片取女子胸部以上的形象，面孔被一条完全竖直的线分成冷青绿与发光金橙两侧。背景遵循同一分区，左青绿、右平坦橙色，因此色彩边界同时穿过人物与其身后空间。她正面朝向镜头，神情从容而略显疏离。深色头发松松盘起，有几缕较柔的发丝落在两侧。脸的左半位于蓝绿暗调，右半则由橙黄亮光呈现。两只眼睛分别在拼缝两侧保持可见；鼻子和嘴唇被线条平分，强调取景的对称。她一只手抬到颈部右侧附近，手指由暖光勾出。带针织或网眼感的衣物盖住肩膀，细密重复的纹路在两种色域中都可辨。左肩以深青绿衬较亮的青绿底色，右肩则以橙色衬饱和金色背景。照片在色彩处理之下保留自然面部塑形：细微的脸颊体积、眼睑、发丝和衣褶仍清楚，虽然中性色已被替换。光线相当柔和且从正面来，中央边界体现的是强烈色彩切换，而非真实的硬投影。下方衣服周围的角落稍暗，上方背景仍干净宽阔。整体构图直接且富图形感，以唯一中央拼缝把从容人物固定在两种相反的发光色温之间。
style_prompt_en: A duotone photographic treatment divides a composition into opposing cool and warm color territories with a crisp straight seam. Saturated teal and blue-green carry the shadow side; golden yellow and hot orange transform the lit side, leaving almost no neutral color. The color division crosses foreground and background alike, making a simple spatial scene read as a graphic design. Natural surface detail remains visible within the tinted zones: subtle volume, fine texture, and small folds prevent the image from becoming a flat poster. The main lighting is soft and frontal; the abrupt border is a color treatment rather than a cast shadow. Large clean background areas frame a centrally placed, closely cropped focal form. The overall visual effect is bold and balanced, built from the tension of two luminous temperatures and one decisive geometric boundary.
style_prompt_zh: 双色摄影处理以清晰笔直的拼缝把构图分成相反的冷暖色域。饱和青绿与蓝绿承担暗面，金黄和炽橙改写受光面，几乎不留中性色。颜色分界同时横穿前景和背景，使简单空间读起来像图形设计。自然表面细节仍留在染色区域内：微妙体积、细纹理和小褶皱阻止图像变成扁平海报。主要照明柔和且正面；骤然边界是色彩处理，而非投影。大片干净的背景色域框住居中且贴近取景的焦点形体。整体大胆均衡，由两种发光色温与一道果断几何边界的张力构成。
theme_en: A frontal fashion portrait split into teal and golden-orange color fields
theme_zh: 一幅正面时尚肖像被青绿与金橙两色域分割
name: Duotone colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
